events.body:
## Context

BLT-Home (`blt-home/`) is rated **Silver** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-home): it meets 86% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Gold (it is looked after: the BLT theme, a contributing guide, recent commits, several contributors and triaged issues)

- **Contributing guide.** Add CONTRIBUTING.md (or a Contributing section in the README): how to set up, test, and open a pull request on git.owaspblt.org, linking the root CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.
- **Two or more contributors this year.** Grow the contributors: label a few small issues `good first issue` and link them from the README.

## Notes

- The activity checks (recent commit, contributors, triage) pass on their own once the work above lands and the open issues get attention.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Contributing guide
- [ ] Two or more contributors this year
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-home` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-home
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-home
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
